title: Beyond Linearization: Attributed Table Graphs for Table Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2601.08444v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Table reasoning, a task to answer questions by reasoning over data presented in tables, is an important topic due to the prevalence of knowledge stored in tabular formats. Recent solutions use Large Language Models (LLMs) for their semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities. A common paradigm of such solutions linearizes tables to form plain texts that are served as input to LLMs. This paradigm has critical issues. It requires LLMs to infer row-column-cell relations from serialized inputs, makes evidence paths harder to trace, and is subject to the "lost-in-the-middle" issue. To address these issues, we propose Table Graph Reasoner (TabGR), a model that represents tables as an Attributed Table Graph (ATG) without task-specific training. The ATG explicitly preserves row-column-cell structure while enabling graph-based reasoning over traceable evidence paths. We further propose a Question-Guided Personalized PageRank (QG-PPR) me

translated_title: 超越线性化：用于表格推理的属性表格图
translated_abstract: 表格推理是一项通过对表格中呈现的数据进行推理来回答问题的任务，由于表格格式中存储的知识普遍存在，因此这是一个重要课题。最近的解决方案利用大型语言模型（LLMs）的语义理解和推理能力。这类解决方案的一种常见范式是将表格线性化为纯文本，作为LLMs的输入。这种范式存在关键问题：它要求LLMs从序列化输入中推断行-列-单元格关系，使证据路径难以追踪，并且容易受到“中间丢失”问题的影响。为解决这些问题，我们提出了表格图推理器（TabGR），一种将表格表示为属性表格图（ATG）的模型，无需特定任务训练。ATG显式保留了行-列-单元格结构，同时支持基于可追踪证据路径的图推理。我们进一步提出了一种问题引导的个性化PageRank（QG-PPR）机制。
tldr: 本文提出TabGR模型，通过属性表格图显式保留表格结构，避免线性化带来的推理困难，并利用问题引导的个性化PageRank实现可追踪的图推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TabGR, which represents tables as Attributed Table Graphs to explicitly preserve structure, avoiding linearization issues and enabling traceable graph-based reasoning via question-guided personalized PageRank.
